replication.target_description: Au and Feldman replication, Problem 11 (part 1): low versus high risk plan without a specific goal; post-exclusion participant sample; two-outcome proportion/binomial test.

n.location: Main manuscript p.51, Problem 11 (part 1); supplementary p.47, Table 13

n.exclusions: Post-exclusion sample: initial 497 reduced to 377 after validation checks; exclusions include low English proficiency, low seriousness, prior exposure, incomplete responses, failed attention checks, and <5 seconds on decision-style scale or a scenario question (main p.24; supplementary pp.33,47). Problems 6 and 7 were assigned to separate randomized subsets.

notes:
Original primary source unavailable: terminal shared-cache miss 70261a7726352a0c4136073d.miss records DOI landing 403, no OpenAlex OA location, CiteSeer 404, and historical Stanford connection failure. No original statistics substituted from the replication. Replication cache title and authors match supplied reference. Problem 11 part 1 is the no-specific-goal arm, not a direct between-arm contrast. Narrative verdict concerns the two-arm pattern jointly; the extracted h/p are for part 1 only.
Source follow-up: Published 1999 Cognitive Psychology article, Goals as Reference Points, by Chip Heath, Richard P. Larrick and George Wu. Unassigned replication is a placeholder. n lists the two printed condition sample sizes (65 do-your-best; 66 specific goal), without deriving a combined N. The printed p value is for their comparison, not a separate within-condition test. No numerical chi-square statistic is printed.
